The analysis combines licensed annual financial statements, annual-report announcement dates, annual controls, daily stock returns, and date-stamped trading-status transitions. The updated control file covers 2000-2025 and supplies complete industry codes for the fiscal years used in the analysis. The annual financial file supplies fiscal-year features and announcement dates through fiscal year 2024. The status-transition file contains 4,192 unique firm-date-transition records for 1,231 firms from 28 April 1998 through 9 June 2026. The latest fiscal-year-2024 announcement is 30 April 2025. Its 30-day scoring date is 30 May 2025 and its one-year outcome window closes on 30 May 2026. No primary record is right-censored by the status file. Fiscal year 2025 is not used even though some control fields are available. Its annual-report scoring date would occur in 2026 and its full one-year outcome would require status coverage into 2027. Treating a newer covariate record as an observed outcome would create false recency. Financial firms are removed when the updated industry code begins with J. Annual records must contain all ten inputs and a report announcement date. Daily return volatility requires at least 30 trading days. Continuous features are winsorized using only the 2011-2018 training period at its 1st and 99th percentiles.
